title: Preparing to Play
question: Is there a restriction to the number of cards in a deck?
answer: Yes, there is. A deck must be constructed with exactly 50 cards.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Are there any requirements to consider when constructing a deck?
answer: Yes, there are. A deck must be constructed entirely using either one or two card colors. Four card types can be included in a deck: Unit, Pilot, Command, and Base.

title: Preparing to Play
question: How many copies of a card with the same card number can be included in a deck?
answer: Up to four copies of a card with the same card number can be included.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Can I include four copies of the ST01-001 Gundam card as well as four copies of the GD01-013 Gundam card in my deck?
answer: Yes, you can. As long as their card numbers are different, you can include four copies of each different card in your deck, even if their card names are the same.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Is there a restriction to the number of cards in a resource deck?
answer: Yes, there is. A resource deck must be constructed with exactly ten cards.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Are there any requirements to consider when constructing a resource deck?
answer: Yes, there are. A resource deck must be constructed using only cards of the Resource card type. Any number of copies of Resource cards with the same card number may be included.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Where do I place tokens that I've brought for use with my deck?
answer: Place them together someplace outside of the playing area.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Do cards placed into the shield section of the shield area have a particular order?
answer: Yes. Place them so that the top card from your deck becomes the bottom Shield.

title: Preparing to Play
question: When and how are Player One and Player Two determined?
answer: Play a game of rock paper scissors or use a similar method. The winner then chooses who goes first before looking at their starting hand.

title: Preparing to Play
question: Can I redraw my starting hand?
answer: Yes. Each player can redraw their starting hand once, starting with Player One. If you choose to redraw your hand, return your entire original hand to the bottom of your deck and draw five new cards from the top of your deck to create a new starting hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

title: Preparing to Play
question: What is an EX Base?
answer: An EX Base is a Base token with 0 AP and 3 HP that both players place in the base section of their shield areas at the start of the game.

title: Preparing to Play
question: What is an EX Resource?
answer: An EX Resource is a Resource token that Player Two places in their resource area at the start of the game. Some effects also place EX Resources during the game.

title: Start Phase
question: Can I leave a card rested during my start phase rather than setting it as active?
answer: No, you cannot.

title: Draw Phase
question: Can I choose not to draw a card during my draw phase?
answer: No, you cannot.

title: Draw Phase
question: Can Player One draw a card during the draw phase of their first turn?
answer: Yes, they can.

title: Draw Phase
question: Is there a maximum number of cards that can be in a hand?
answer: No, there is not. However, if you have 11 or more cards in your hand during your end phase, you must discard down to 10 cards.

title: Draw Phase
question: As a result of drawing a card from my deck, it now has no cards in it. At this time, what happens to the game?
answer: The moment a deck has no cards in it, that player loses the game.

title: Resource Phase
question: Can I choose not to place a Resource during my resource phase?
answer: No, you cannot.

title: Resource Phase
question: Is there a maximum number of cards that can be in the resource area?
answer: Yes, there is. Up to 10 Resource cards from the resource deck and 5 EX Resource cards can be placed into the resource area, for a total of 15 cards.

title: Resource Phase
question: If a resource deck has no cards in it, does the resource phase occur?
answer: It does occur, and then that turn immediately advances to the main phase since there are no cards.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: When determining my Lv. while playing a card, do I include EX Resources in my resource area?
answer: Yes, you do. If you have two Resources and one EX Resource, you can play any card that is Lv.3 or less.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: When playing a card, I paid its cost with an EX Resource, so that EX Resource was removed from the game. Afterwards, what happens to the Lv. of cards I can play?
answer: Since the EX Resource was removed from the game and the number of Resources has decreased, the Lv. of cards you can play decreases by the same amount.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: How do I play a Command card with a Pilot effect as a Pilot?
answer: After paying the card's cost as you normally would to play it, pair it with a Unit as a Pilot instead of activating its Command effect.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: Can I deploy a Unit if there is already a Unit with the same card name deployed in my battle area?
answer: Yes, you can.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: Can I pair a Pilot with a Unit if there is already a Pilot with the same card name paired with another Unit in my battle area?
answer: Yes, you can.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: Is there a maximum number of Units that can be deployed into the battle area?
answer: Yes, there is. Up to six Units can be deployed into the battle area.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: When there are already six Units deployed, can I deploy a new Unit?
answer: Yes, you can. If you want to deploy a new Unit when the battle area is full, place one previously deployed Unit into the trash, then deploy the new Unit. The Unit placed into the trash at this time is not treated as being destroyed.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: Is there a maximum number of Bases that can be deployed into the base section of the shield area?
answer: Yes, there is. Up to one Base can be deployed into the base section of the shield area.

title: Main Phase: Playing Cards
question: When a Base is already deployed, can I deploy a new Base?
answer: Yes, you can. Place the previously deployed Base into the trash, then deploy the new Base. The Base placed into the trash at this time is not treated as being destroyed.

title: Main Phase: Activating Card Effects
question: Can I activate the 【Activate･Main】 effect on a Unit during the same turn it was deployed?
answer: Yes, you can.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: Can Player One attack during their first turn?
answer: Yes, they can. However, Units cannot immediately attack during the turn in which they are deployed.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: What happens when an attack on a player occurs?
answer: When a player is attacked, check if there are cards in their shield area. If a Base is present, the Base is attacked. Otherwise, the first Shield is attacked. If no cards are in the shield area, the opposing player themselves is attacked directly.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: If the attacking Unit or the Unit being targeted moves to another location, what happens to that attack?
answer: Advance to the battle end step, skipping all steps in between.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: Can a Unit with 0 AP attack?
answer: Yes, it can.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: Can an attack from a Unit with 0 AP destroy an opponent's Shield?
answer: No, it cannot. Each Shield is treated as having 1 HP.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: Can I choose which Shield is destroyed?
answer: No, you cannot. If multiple Shields are present, destroy the first Shield.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: Can I destroy a Shield instead of destroying a Base?
answer: No, you cannot.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: If a Command card with 【Action】 timing has a Pilot effect, can I pair it as a Pilot during an action step?
answer: No, you cannot.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: When a battle between two Units occurs, how is damage dealt between them?
answer: Each Unit deals damage equal to its AP to the other unit simultaneously. If the attacking Unit has , that Unit deals damage first. If the other Unit is destroyed as a result, the attacking Unit does not receive damage.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: When a Shield is destroyed, what happens to it?
answer: The destroyed Shield is revealed and placed into the trash. If it has a 【Burst】 effect, choose whether or not to activate that 【Burst】 effect before it is placed into the trash.

title: Main Phase: Unit Attacks
question: If a Unit paired with a Pilot is destroyed or otherwise moves to another location such as due to an effect, what happens to the paired Pilot?
answer: It moves to the same location as the Unit. Move it to the trash if the Unit is destroyed, or to your hand with the Unit if the Unit is returned to your hand.

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: What does "play" mean?
answer: This describes paying the cost of a card in your hand and using it.

answer: This describes when a Unit enters the battle area or a Base enters the base section of the shield area.

title: Fundamental Terminology

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: What does "recover" mean?

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: What does "pair" mean?
answer: This describes placing a Pilot card or a Command card with a Pilot effect beneath a Unit.

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: What is a "Link Unit"?
answer: Some Units have link requirements, such as Pilot names or traits, listed on them. A Unit paired with a Pilot that satisfies its link requirements is called a Link Unit. Link Units can attack immediately on the turn they are deployed.

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: What is a "token"?
answer: A token is anything placed into play from outside the game by an effect. EX Bases and EX Resources placed at the start of the game are also tokens.

title: Fundamental Terminology
question: Some effects use "/" characters to list multiple items in a row, such as traits. For example, "1 (Zeon)/(Neo Zeon) Unit card." What does this mean?
answer: The "/" character represents the conjunction "or." If an effect reads "1 (Zeon)/(Neo Zeon) Unit card," you can choose either one (Zeon) Unit card or one (Neo Zeon) Unit card.

question: What does 【Activate･Main】 mean?
answer: It means that effect can be activated during your main phase by fulfilling any conditions listed before the "：" character.

title: Activate

title: During Pair

answer: It means the effect activates when the Unit is paired with a Pilot and it attacks. If a Pilot is not paired with the Unit, the 【Attack】 effect will not activate.

title: Once per Turn
question: What does 【Once per Turn】 mean?
answer: It means the effect including 【Once per Turn】 will not activate more than one time during the same turn.

title: Once per Turn

title: Burst
question: What does 【Burst】 mean?
answer: If a Shield is destroyed and the revealed Shield card has a 【Burst】 effect, it means that effect can be activated before the card is placed into the trash.

title: Burst

title: Miscellaneous
question: If two or more of my effects activate simultaneously, can I choose the order I resolve them in?

title: Miscellaneous
question: If multiple effects activate at the same time, how do players resolve them?

title: Miscellaneous
question: Multiple effects activate at the same time and a new effect activates while they are being resolved. At this time, how do players resolve the effects?
